sections.title: Adjusted
items: Admin test sieges can now use seven more castle maps that are still being checked. Real campaign sieges use the same maps as before.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Change gear during warmup without respawning. Your choices apply automatically the next time you spawn, even if you rejoin the same battle.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The loadout panel now shows shorter spawn messages, including “Applies on next spawn” during warmup.

sections.title: New
items: Practise with your team's gear during warmup for free, then bring the same loadout into battle.
Place your team's Ammo Box with Shift + Deploy, then hold F at the box to refill arrows or bolts from team stock.

sections.title: Fixed
items: You can now spawn with the rest of your loadout when an item runs out. Red chat text tells you which gear was skipped.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Human and AI defenders in AI garrisons use the same armour. Villages get light armour and towns and castles get medium armour.
AI garrisons get three Healing Tents and three Forward Spawns in stock. Each placement spends a kit.

sections.title: Disabled
items: Free arrow barrels on campaign maps are disabled during live combat.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Portable ladders now lower four times faster after being placed while still settling cleanly against walls and floors.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed siege defending bots not marching over to destroy an attacker Forward Spawn placed inside the castle walls.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Portable ladders now lower three times faster after being placed while still settling cleanly against walls and floors.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed hidden teammate markers continuing to run off-screen overhead calculations before they were first toggled.
Fixed destroyed pavise shields leaving invisible collision blockers behind after breaking.
Aligned portable ladder climb-hold timing between the client and server so ladders respond consistently.
Fixed siege defending archers sharing a duplicate battlement group so all four archer groups hold separate wall sections.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Reduced client and server engine work during large battles and sieges so gameplay stays smoother with many players, mounts and NPC defenders.
Spread simultaneous reinforcement spawns cleanly across consecutive ticks while keeping wave timing, fairness and battle accounting unchanged.
Reduced stutter during banner, tent, cart and ladder placement, match-end processing, and round team balancing.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Administrators carrying a hammer can enable the admin hammer bonus without changing equipment during battle.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Each side can now keep two tents and two carts deployed. Both tents and carts have their own markers, and overlapping tents do not heal twice as fast.
Cart spawning can use another available friendly cart when one is blocked or has no free spawn position.
Donkeys are slightly slower.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Battle reports distinguish combat losses from campaign penalties and show recorded spoils.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Flag defeats now remove 60% of surviving troops instead of reducing the defeated party to one soldier.
After a defeat, unused equipment is split: 50% to the winner, 35% returned to the loser and 15% destroyed. Whole-item rounding applies.
Defeat transfers 70% of remaining trading goods to the winner; the loser keeps the rest.
Retreat transfers 10% of unused equipment and trading goods to the winner, alongside the existing 30% troop penalty.
Winning armies, AI parties and defending settlements receive the appropriate spoils.
